info.title: Blobz Hosted Avatar API
info.description: Render deterministic Blobz avatars through a browser-friendly SVG image endpoint. Each paid account receives one stable endpoint ID and approves up to five exact browser origins.

tags.name: Avatars
tags.description: Deterministic SVG avatars for approved browser origins.

get.description: Returns a deterministic SVG avatar. Cross-origin browser requests must include an Origin header matching one of the account's approved origins. Requests from the Blobz deployment serving the docs are allowed automatically. Only successful responses consume the account-wide monthly allowance.

parameters.name: endpointId
parameters.description: The stable public endpoint ID shown in the Blobz dashboard.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: An exact approved HTTPS origin, or an approved localhost HTTP origin during development. Browsers set this for cross-origin images that use crossorigin="anonymous". Same-origin requests from the Blobz deployment do not need to set it manually.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A name, username, email, or opaque stable ID. Input is trimmed and must contain 1 to 256 characters.

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: Two comma-separated six-digit hex colours: background first, body second. A leading # is optional before each colour.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The rendered SVG width and height in pixels.

200.description: SVG avatar. RateLimit headers describe the account-wide monthly quota.

Access-Control-Allow-Origin.description: The approved account origin or trusted platform origin echoed exactly.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Successful requests remaining in the current usage window.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the current usage window resets.

403.description: The Origin header is missing from a non-platform request or unapproved, or the subscription is inactive.

value.error: Use an image with crossorigin from an approved origin.
This origin is not approved for this account.

404.description: The endpoint ID does not exist or has been revoked.

414.description: The complete request URL is longer than 4096 characters.

422.description: A required parameter is missing, unknown, repeated, or malformed.

429.description: The monthly quota or the 10,000 requests/minute account burst limit was reached. Retry-After is expressed in seconds.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the request can be retried.
